payload.title: LRO LOLA derived gridded topography candidate

payload.next_action: Use the checked LOLA byte-range fixtures for software proof, then add illumination and wider corridor search before any rover claim.
notes: PDS Geosciences identifies LOLA as the LRO Lunar Orbiter Laser Altimeter for high-resolution lunar topography.
The PDS page lists derived GDR and SLDEM product families and points recent LOLA data discovery to ODE/LOLA Data Node.
The first trusted-square active fixture now uses a checked LOLA GDR byte-range extraction for software proof.
